title: Literature review and problem formulation
description: Studied the paper "Stability and Performance of Compound TCP With a Proportional Integral Queue Policy" and identified the opportunity to push queuing delay to its theoretical limit using a Threshold Based Queuing policy.

title: Mathematical modeling and AIMD parameter extraction
description: Developed a mathematical model to analyze saw-teeth timeseries data and extract AIMD (Additive Increase Multiplicative Decrease) parameters, enabling integration of the Threshold Based Queuing policy with the existing TCP-IP protocol stack.

title: NS3 simulation and evaluation
description: Implemented Threshold Based Queuing policy in NS3 simulation. Achieved 50% less queuing delay without compromising on throughput, compared to drop-tail.

title: Paper publication
description: Published "A mechanism for TCP-aware adaptive management of queues in Internet routers" at IEEE.
